detail.longDescription: Was reading a write up talking about how # Omarchy set up for # docker was a security issue. This led to me finding out about # podman . Seems interesting. I am more of a hobbyist, so a lot of my choices are somewhat less relevant for my own # homelab , but part of me does like to choose what is the most fossy of solutions for its own sake. I am thinking of switching over. Part for the learning exercise of migrating tools and seeing how I like it. Will have to look more into it for a final decision. A big part of my homelab is for my own professional development, so I am also curious which path is more beneficial to that.
